The test image shows tomato leaves with:
- Many small, scattered dark brown/black lesions across leaf surfaces
- Some spots appear to have lighter borders or halos
- Lesions look angular in some areas
- No clear concentric rings visible
- Plant part: leaf

This points to either **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch** (small circular tan/gray spots with dark borders and pycnidia) or **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato** (small angular black spots with yellow halos).

I'll use my one reference view on Septoria_Leaf_Blotch to confirm.

The reference Septoria image shows small circular spots with tan/gray centers and dark brown borders - consistent with what I see in the test image. Both show numerous small scattered lesions across green tomato leaves.

The test image matches Septoria_Leaf_Blotch well:
- Many small dark brown lesions scattered across leaf surface
- Some spots show lighter centers with dark borders (characteristic pycnidia pattern)
- No concentric rings (rules out Early_Blight)
- Not angular enough for Bacterial_Speck, and no clear yellow halos
